concerns.text: SC‑003 (execution time ≤ 6 h) has no implementing task that records or asserts the pipeline’s runtime. Add a task (e.g., T019) to measure total execution time and fail if it exceeds the threshold.
SC‑004 (peak memory usage < 7 GB) lacks a task that monitors memory consumption and validates the limit. Add a task (e.g., T020) to profile peak RAM usage and enforce the constraint.

Constitution principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksums of generated datasets, but no task records these checksums. Add a checksum‑generation task (e.g., T021) that computes and stores hashes for all files under `data/`.
